name: Urgent care clinic

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Marcus (physician assistant) and Nadia (nurse practitioner), with the front desk

services.name: Urgent care visit
services.story: The main story: a time this morning, about 11:00am; sicker patients may go first. Nothing is taken. The desk checks Alex's plan by hand, and Alex pays the $35 copay at the front desk (self-pay: $150). A test added in the room is paid there too, and a balance after the plan pays is billed by the clinic its own way.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Ravi (nurse practitioner, on call) and Luis (physician assistant, the backup), who drive out with a kit
B.customer: Alex M. (patient, at home) · other patients

services.name: House call
services.story: The main story: a house call sent now, Ravi on call. Nothing is taken. The office bills Alex's plan its own way, then Alex for any share.

services.name: House call
services.story: The same house call, paid by Alex: $179 on the price list. Nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the bill when Ravi texts DONE. A hotel visit for a traveler runs the same way.

services_shape: a saved spot in today's line at the clinic: an estimated time, not an appointment, and sicker patients are seen first; walk-ins join the same line; tests or treatment are added in the room from the price list, with the patient's yes first; a house call or hotel visit is sent now with an arrival estimate, or booked in an arrival window; a video visit
questions_before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only (illness or injury, a test, a physical, a video visit), never a symptom typed into the AI
a health plan (its name only) or paying yourself
for a house call: the address, inside the travel area
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, stroke signs (a drooping face, a weak arm, trouble speaking, a sudden severe headache), heavy bleeding, fainting or a seizure, or someone who can't wake up
swallowed something poisonous, or too much of a medicine
first_steps: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
license: always: each clinician (physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, nurse) holds their own active license from the state's board
staff_skills: every clinician on shift sees illness and injury visits; stitches and X-ray reads by the clinicians trained for them; only clinicians cleared for house calls go out with the mobile kit
messages_never: texts to the patient carry only the clinic's name, the date, the estimated time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, symptoms, medicines, the reason, results or children's details; the mobile clinician's first name stays in house-call texts, for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
